spanish: Y harás el altar maderas de acacia; cinco codos largo y cinco codos ancho; cuadrado será el altar, y tres codos su alto.

findings.issue: שִׁטִּים is feminine plural; singular acacia names the species. Number smoothing that does not change the wood.

notes: Altar and acacia wood stay juxtaposed, as in the Hebrew, which has no preposition between them.
